name: Turbulent Epee

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Turbulent Burst
effects.tooltip: Turbulent Burst : This weapon is enchanted with wild, unpredictable energy. It will do 1 to 8 damage of a random energy type (fire/cold/electric/acid) on a successful hit and 3 to 24 damage of a random energy type on critical hits.

effects.name: Treason
effects.tooltip: Treason : This item reduces the threat generated by melee damage by 20%.

effects.name: Metalline
effects.tooltip: Metalline : Metalline bypasses any metal based damage reduction. ( Adamantine , "Alchemical, Silver" , Byeshk , Cold Iron , Mithral )

effects.name: Aligned
effects.tooltip: Aligned : This weapon transmutes into a form that is able to bypass any alignment based Damage Reduction. (Chaotic, Good, Evil, Lawful)

flavor_text: A rapier, once well-kept by its original Elven owner, which has become twisted and warped by the plane of Madness. Xoriat has granted this sword the ability to unleash the elements upon its foes, but it never seems to settle on one type...
